fear_greed.commentary: The index sank deeper into extreme fear at 19 after Tuesday's session, down from 23 a day earlier and well below 34 a week ago and 38 a month ago.

breadth.label: Percent of S&P 500 stocks above 50-day MA
breadth.note: Below 30 bullish, above 70 bearish. Computed by Thaddeus from Yahoo Finance daily closes for 501 of 503 current S&P 500 constituents at the Nov. 3 close (mimics MMFI). Breadth slipped even as the cap-weighted S&P rose, since big tech led while most stocks fell.

markets.summary: Monday's pattern flipped on Election Day: chip stocks rebounded and lifted the Nasdaq 0.83% and the S&P 500 0.36%, snapping a three-day losing streak, while the Dow slipped 0.38% as Apple fell after its report; most S&P stocks actually declined, 314 to 189. Tech led, with Microsoft up about 3% and Nvidia and Amazon up more than 2%, but the Nasdaq is still down 4.2% on the week and 6.7% on the month, with RSI near 36 and MACD below its signal line. Small caps edged up, with the Russell 2000 rising 0.2% to 2,812, right at its 40-week average. Stronger job-openings and factory-orders data pushed the 10-year Treasury yield up to about 4.95%, roughly 19% higher this year. Gold futures fell 0.7% to about $3,940 and silver futures 2.2% to about $49.59; both remain well below their 40-week averages, with silver down about 29% year to date and its RSI under 30.

stories.headline: SpaceX gains 3.6% on reported Boost Mobile talks
stories.summary: Shares closed at $141.31 after The Washington Post reported SpaceX is in talks to buy EchoStar's Boost Mobile or use its network, which could jump-start Starlink Mobile; neither company has confirmed, and T-Mobile has ruled out a network deal.

stories.headline: SpaceX's Q3 call highlights aggressive AI compute expansion
stories.summary: SpaceX beat estimates with Q3 revenue of $14.58 billion, up 161%, and guided Q4 capital spending to $35-40 billion as Musk targets at least 13 GW of compute by the end of 2027.

stories.headline: Cameco slides for a third straight session
stories.summary: CCJ fell another 1.1% to $72.56 Tuesday, extending its post-earnings slide after the Key Lake mill outage; it is down about 12% over the past week.

stories.headline: Nvidia rallies as Huang's backing of the Marvell-Lumentum deal comes to light
stories.summary: NVDA rose 2.3% to $206.69, snapping a four-day losing streak, after reports that Jensen Huang endorsed the $115 billion Marvell-Lumentum merger and that Nvidia told cloud clients to sell at least 51% of services outside China.

stories.headline: Melius cuts Nvidia target to $315, keeps Buy
stories.summary: Melius Research trimmed its price target from $420 citing valuation pressure, ahead of Nvidia's Nov. 17 earnings report.

headlines.headline: S&P 500 snaps 3-day skid on Election Day as chip stocks rebound
headlines.summary: The Nasdaq rose 0.83% and the S&P 500 0.36% as investors moved back into tech ahead of midterm results, while Apple dragged the Dow down 0.38%; the Nasdaq-100 remains in correction territory.

headlines.headline: Chips rebound, job openings and factory orders beat, AMD jumps after hours
headlines.summary: Only 189 S&P 500 stocks rose while chips gained 2.6%; stronger data pushed the 10-year yield to about 4.95%, and AMD rose about 7% after hours on an earnings beat.

weather.summary: A front from the Upper Great Lakes to the Lower Mississippi Valley pushes east toward the Appalachians, bringing storms and a Slight Risk of flash flooding to the Lower Mississippi and Tennessee valleys, while heavy showers continue on Florida's southeast coast. Out west, a Pacific system brings rain and mountain snow to California, the Great Basin and Colorado's high country on Wednesday, and rain spreads into the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic by Thursday.
